intent: Inline colour picker for theming and branding settings: saturation/brightness area, hue track, optional opacity track, hex Input, and optional preset swatches. One piece, no popover.
useWhen: Picking a brand, theme, label, or chart colour in a settings form
Offering a short brand palette as presets with a free-form fallback
Inside Field when the colour needs a label, hint, or error
doNotUseWhen: Choosing among a few named options that happen to be colours, with no free pick — use RadioGroup
Styling the kit's own UI — use semantic tokens, not a picked colour
A trigger button that opens a picker panel — not built yet; place ColorPicker inline

value.note: Controlled hex. #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA when showAlpha and opacity is below 100%. Accepts #RGB / #RGBA / #RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA, case-insensitive.

defaultValue.note: Uncontrolled starting hex. With neither value nor defaultValue the picker starts at black.

onChange.note: (hex: string) => void. Uppercase #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA with showAlpha below 100% opacity. Fires on every committed change (drag, keys, swatch, valid hex).

swatches.note: (string | { value, label? })[]. Preset colours shown as a radio group. The label is the accessible name; without it the hex is read out.

showAlpha.note: Adds an opacity track over a checkerboard and a percent readout.

id.note: Hex Input id. Inside Field, pass the same value as htmlFor so the Field label names the hex Input.

describedBy.note: Set by Field (hint or error id).

error.note: Set by Field when it has an error. Danger border on the hex Input.

ariaLabel.note: Names the group and prefixes the slider names: '{ariaLabel} saturation and brightness', '{ariaLabel} hue', '{ariaLabel} opacity', '{ariaLabel} presets'. Use the Field label text, e.g. 'Brand colour'.

invalidMessage.note: Shown under the hex Input while the typed text is not a valid hex. The last valid colour is kept.

colorData.note: The picked colour is user data, not a design decision. It is painted with inline style on the area hue, the thumbs, the preview, the opacity track, and the swatches. The hue spectrum and the white/black area overlays are built from the component's own HSV math, never literal colours in CSS. This is not a token violation. All chrome — borders, focus rings, radius, thumb rings, checkerboard, text, spacing — uses the semantic tokens listed under tokens.

requirements: Area is one role=slider with aria-roledescription '2D slider': ← → saturation, ↑ ↓ brightness, 1 per press, Shift ×10; PageUp/PageDown brightness ±10; Home/End saturation 0/100. aria-valuetext 'Saturation 80%, brightness 60%'
Hue is role=slider 0 to 359: ← → (or ↑ ↓) 1 degree, Shift ×10, PageUp/PageDown ±10, Home/End. aria-valuetext '210 degrees, blue'
Opacity (showAlpha) is role=slider 0 to 100 with the same keys. aria-valuetext '80%'
Pointer: click or drag the area and tracks; the control takes focus so keys continue from there
Swatches are role=radiogroup of role=radio buttons with aria-checked, one Tab stop (roving tabindex). Arrows move and select, Home/End jump. Name is the swatch label or its hex

Hex Input uses kit Input with '#' in the start slot. A complete 6 or 8 digit hex applies while typing; 3 or 4 digit short forms apply on blur or Enter. 3/6 digits keep the current opacity; 4/8 digits set it. A swatch sets full opacity
Invalid hex sets aria-invalid on the Input, shows invalidMessage (role=alert) linked by aria-describedby, and keeps the last valid colour
Inside Field, Field label htmlFor matches id; Field describedBy and error land on the hex Input
disabled removes every part from the Tab order and blocks pointer and keys
Colour is never the only cue: the selected swatch has a ring, and every value has text (hex, valuetext, percent)

doNot: Do not invent ColorArea, HueSlider, AlphaSlider, ColorSwatch, ColorInput, or SwatchPicker cousins — use ColorPicker props
Do not use a native input type=color
Do not add a colour library; hex/HSV conversion lives in the component
Do not use a picked colour for kit chrome; it is content
Do not put raw hex or rgb()/hsl() in CSS; the picked colour arrives through inline style only
Do not wrap ColorPicker in a Popover or Drawer as a picker trigger without a plan task
snippet:
<Field label="Brand colour" htmlFor="brand-colour" hint="Used for buttons and links.">
  <ColorPicker id="brand-colour" ariaLabel="Brand colour" value={brand} onChange={setBrand} swatches={["#2F6FEB", { value: "#0E9F6E", label: "Green" }]} />
</Field>
